subject: [PATCH 6.18.y] mm: page_alloc: make defrag_mode retries follow the promoted order

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of page allocation in Linux's mm module to make defrag_mode retries follow the promoted order, rather than the original request order. This change is intended to prevent a reclaim storm that occurs when non-movable requests are made under defrag_mode. The patch introduces changes to how progress is reported and handled during direct reclaim and compaction, with the goal of reducing unnecessary retries and improving system performance.
